chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutevakil (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar quoted Muhammad ibn Ahmad, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ali al-Hamdani, on the authority of Umar ibn Isa, on the authority of Forat ibn Ahnaf, who said:

Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was questioned about leeks, so he said: 'Eat them all, for in them are four characteristics: it makes the breath smell fresh, it expels wind, it stops hemorrhoids, and it is a protection from leprosy for one who consumes it constantly.'
ai.seo_question: What are the four health benefits of leeks according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Khisal*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the medicinal virtues of leeks (*al-karath*), linking their consumption to both physical health and spiritual protection. The narration highlights four specific benefits: freshening breath, expelling wind, curing hemorrhoids, and serving as a safeguard against leprosy (*al-judham*) for those who consume it regularly, reflecting the Shia tradition of integrating prophetic medicine with daily life.
